newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: TOBACCO GIANT BAT PLANS EXPANSION - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: TOBACCO GIANT BAT PLANS EXPANSION - REPORT.

text.p: One of the world's leading tobacco companies British American Tobacco is hoping to grab a bigger share of Lithuania's market this year, daily Lieutuvos rytas on Thursday quoted company officials as saying.

BAT public relations director Ole Ernvall was quoted by the paper as saying that he thinks there are ways to compete with Philip Morris , the leading cigarette seller in Lithuania with an 85 percent market share.
BAT last year had just 1.5 percent of the market, the newspaper added.
It also quoted a local BAT representative as saying that the compnay's market share in Estonia was six percent and 11 percent in Latvia.
